summary.intent: Ensure the firmware-tests shards, previously set up as required checks, are enforced when they run, without making them unconditionally required, by adding a gate job to the CI workflow.
summary.outcome: A gate job was added to .depot/workflows/ci.yml along with an updated rules note, then tested and committed. The transcript doesn't show test results.

repo: CI is defined in .depot/workflows/ci.yml (Depot CI), not GitHub Actions' .github/workflows.
firmware-tests runs as multiple shards that were configured as individual required checks.
Required checks for sharded jobs that may be skipped can block merges; an aggregate gate job is used instead to require them only when they run.

code.finding: Gate job added that depends on the firmware-tests shards so a single check enforces their success if they run; exact line numbers not shown in the transcript.

workflow: A single aggregate gate job as the required check is a cleaner alternative to removing required checks on conditionally-run shards.
Confirm branch and file tail before editing CI config, then test and commit.

friction: Individually required shard checks conflict with shards that are conditionally skipped, which prompted this change.
open_items: Update branch protection to require the new gate job and remove the individual firmware-tests shard required checks, if not already done.
Verify the gate behaves correctly when shards are skipped versus failed in a real CI run.
